entity.summary: Middle East and North Africa digital-asset exchange platform offering local-currency funding, spot and limit orders, transfers, withdrawals, and over-the-counter trading.
entity.notes: CoinMENA's first-party site identifies the Bahrain-headquartered CoinMENA B.S.C. (c) and the UAE operating entity CoinMENA FZE. Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority lists CoinMENA FZE under reference VL/23/09/001 with an active broker-dealer licence for institutional, qualified, and retail investors. VARA issued a notice of fines on 2026-06-22 concerning AML programme control failures and a remediation plan; the same regulator continued to list the licence as active, so the entity remains active and the enforcement action is recorded separately.

events.title: VARA fined CoinMENA over AML control failures
events.description: Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority announced a financial penalty against CoinMENA FZE after identifying administrative and internal-control failures in its anti-money-laundering programme and stated that CoinMENA had begun a coordinated remediation plan.
events.notes: The regulator continued to list CoinMENA FZE as active. The notice does not establish a suspension, withdrawal, or shutdown.

evidence.title: CoinMENA digital asset exchange platform
evidence.notes: Current first-party platform exposes local-currency funding, spot and limit orders, deposits, withdrawals, transfers, and OTC trading.

evidence.title: CoinMENA FZE public register entry
evidence.notes: Official VARA entry identifies CoinMENA FZE, the official website, reference VL/23/09/001, permitted broker-dealer services, licence conditions, and active status.

evidence.title: VARA Notice of Fines – CoinMENA FZE
evidence.notes: Official enforcement notice confirms the financial penalty, AML programme control failures, cooperation, and remediation plan.
